query: 'SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
       p.paciente_key,
       d.departamento_key,
       g.diagnostico_key,
       YEAR(a.admission_date)*10000 + MONTH(a.admission_date)*100 + DAY(a.admission_date) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
       YEAR(a.discharge_date)*10000 + MONTH(a.discharge_date)*100 + DAY(a.discharge_date) AS fecha_alta_key,
       a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
       DATEDIFF(day, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia,
       1 AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
JOIN gold.dim_paciente p       ON p.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
JOIN gold.dim_departamento d   ON d.nombre_departamento = a.department
JOIN silver.diagnoses dx       ON dx.admission_id = a.admission_id
JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico g    ON g.codigo_icd = dx.icd_code
                              AND g.nivel_severidad = COALESCE(dx.severity, 'Desconocido')',
